name: Bauhaus

identity.oneLiner: Bauhaus: one paper sheet, an ink spine, and three elementary forms sharing its edges.
identity.summary: Bauhaus 1919–33: the red square, blue circle, and yellow triangle are cropped by the sheet and locked to one spine. Type is Bayer lowercase; labels are tracked capitals.
identity.authenticityNotes: Forms share edges with the sheet and with each other. A tilted sticker is not a construction.

axes.shape: Red square, blue circle, yellow triangle sharing one spine
axes.edge: Hard ink keylines, like a press sheet
axes.surface: One paper, flat printer's color, no lighting
axes.elevation: A second plane, not a blur
axes.ornament: Geometry is the layout: cropped forms, not stickers
axes.typeVoice: Bayer lowercase display, tracked capital labels

bands.description: Functional typography, reduced ornament and compact composition.
Distinctive era structure with limited graphic emphasis.
Full expressive yet accessible visual composition.

neverDo: No randomly scattered circles and triangles.
No tilted rectangles floating free of the spine.
No primary color text without sufficient contrast.
Never rotate functional labels or fields.
Avoid Memphis confetti, gloss, and gradients.
